title: Assistant Vice President/Vice President, Model Validation, Risk Management Group
description:
DBS Bank has been present in India for 30 years, opening its first office in Mumbai in 1994\. DBS Bank India Limited is the first among the large foreign banks in India to start operating as a wholly owned, locally incorporated subsidiary of a leading global bank. As a trusted partner, DBS provides a range of banking services for large, medium, and small enterprises and individual consumers in India, focusing on a seamless customer experience that helps them ‘Live more, Bank less’. In November 2020, Lakshmi Vilas Bank was merged with DBS Bank India Limited. DBS Bank India is now present in \~350 locations in 19 Indian states.
 



  





**Job Purpose** 




 We are seeking a highly motivated and skilled individual to lead the Model Validation function with Risk Management Group. The successful candidate will be responsible for independently validating a diverse range of credit risk models used across both wholesale and retail banking businesses. This role involves assessing model design, data quality, implementation, and ongoing performance to ensure models are fit for purpose, compliant with regulatory requirements, and effectively manage financial risk.
 



  





**Key Accountabilities** 



* Independent Model Validation: Conduct end\-to\-end independent validation of credit risk models, including but not limited to:
* Wholesale Banking Models: PD, LGD, EAD models for corporate, commercial real estate, and other institutional exposures; stress testing models; counterparty credit risk models; credit rating models
* Retail Banking Models: PD, LGD, EAD models for mortgages, auto loans, credit cards, personal loans; application scorecards, behavioral scorecards, collections models.
* Methodology Review: Critically evaluate model development methodologies, underlying assumptions, conceptual soundness, and quantitative techniques.
* Data Quality Assessment: Assess the quality, completeness, and appropriateness of data used in model development and ongoing monitoring.
* Implementation Review: Verify the accurate and robust implementation of models within relevant systems.
* Performance Monitoring: Review and challenge ongoing model performance monitoring frameworks and results, including backtesting, benchmarking, and sensitivity analysis.
* Governance and Policy: Establish Governance processes and Model validation Policy in line with local regulatory and group requirements.
* Documentation \& Reporting: Prepare comprehensive validation reports detailing findings, limitations, recommendations, and conclusions. Present findings to model owners, developers, and relevant committees.
* Regulatory Compliance: Ensure models and validation practices comply with internal policies and external regulatory requirements (e.g., SR 11\-7, CECL, IFRS 9, Basel Accords).
* Challenging Model Development: Proactively engage with model developers to provide constructive challenge and guidance throughout the model lifecycle.
* Stakeholder Engagement: Collaborate effectively with model development teams, risk management functions, business lines, internal audit, and regulators.
* Continuous Improvement: Contribute to the enhancement of validation processes, methodologies, and tools.



  





**Required Experience** 



* 10\+ years of experience in model validation or model development, specifically with exposure to credit risk models.
* Demonstrable experience with model review and validation pertaining to both wholesale banking and retail banking
* Understanding of technical modelling requirements throughout model life cycle covering data analytics, coding, development, deployment, monitoring and maintenance for both traditional AI and Gen AI models
* Capacity to adopt new modelling areas (e.g., climate risk \& Agentic AI) and problem solving
* nderstanding of model governance requirements and principles



  





**Education / Preferred Qualifications** 




 Post \-graduate/ Graduate degree in quantitative discipline (such as Statistics, Mathematics, Quantitative Finance, Data Analytics or equivalent) is preferred
 



  





**Core Competencies** 



* Deep understanding of credit risk concepts, including PD, LGD, EAD, ECL, credit ratings, credit scores, and stress testing.
* Familiarity with relevant RBI and Basel guidelines
* Understanding of financial products and business processes in both wholesale and retail banking segments.
* Analytical \& Critical Thinking: Exceptional analytical, problem\-solving, and critical thinking skills with the ability to identify subtle model weaknesses and propose practical solutions.
* Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts clearly and concisely to both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Attention to Detail: Meticulous attention to detail and a commitment to producing high\-quality work.
* Collaboration: Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast\-paced environment.
* Experience in a regulated financial institution environment.



  





**Technical Competencies** 



* Strong proficiency in statistical modeling techniques: regression analysis, econometrics, time series analysis, machine learning algorithms (e.g., logistic regression, decision trees, random forests, gradient boosting).
* Expertise in programming languages for data analysis and statistical modeling: Python, R, SAS.
* Familiarity with database querying tools (SQL) is a plus.
* Experience with large datasets and data manipulation.



  





**DBS India \- Culture \& Behaviors** 



* Performance through Value Based Propositions
* Ensure customer focus by delighting customers \& reduce complaints
* Build pride and passion to protect, maintain and enhance DBS’ image and reputation
* Enhance knowledge base, build skill sets \& develop competencies
* Execute at speed while maintaining error free operations
* Maintain the highest standards of honesty and integrity

title: Analytics & Insights Lead
description:
**\#\# The Opportunity** 




  





 At a fast\-growing company, data is rarely the hardest problem. The harder problem is understanding what the data is actually telling you.
 



  





 A business can have dashboards, reports, and hundreds of metrics, and still have five different explanations for why performance changed. One team sees a demand problem. Another sees an execution problem. Someone else sees a capacity issue. The founder looks at the same numbers and asks: "But what is actually going on?"
 



  





 This role exists to answer that question.
 



  





 We are looking for an exceptional analytical generalist who enjoys taking ambiguous business problems, going deep into data, testing competing hypotheses, finding the underlying pattern, and turning it into a clear insight that helps leadership make better decisions.
 



  





 You will work closely with the Founder \& CEO and senior leadership, across functions and business problems.
 



  





 This is deliberately not a conventional reporting or BI role.
 



  





 \-\-\-
 



  





**\#\# What You Will Do** 




  





 Your work will typically move through: Business Question \> Data \> Analysis \> Insight \> Decision \> Outcome.
 



  





 You may start with something as simple as: "Why has this metric changed?"
 



  





 But the real work is figuring out: What actually changed? Where did it change? Is the movement real? What could explain it? Which explanations are supported by evidence? What don't we know? What should we investigate next? What does this mean for the business?
 



  





 You will work across areas including growth, customers, operations, finance, productivity, unit economics, and strategy. The specific questions will change constantly. That is part of the role.
 



  





 \-\-\-
 



  





**\#\# What Makes This Role Unusual** 




  





 You will not be handed a neatly defined analytical problem every morning. Some of the most valuable questions will arrive as:
 



  





 "Something feels wrong with this number."
 



  





 "Three teams have three different explanations. Which one is right?"
 



  





 "We're growing, but I'm not sure we're getting better."
 



  





 Your job will be to turn that ambiguity into a structured investigation. Sometimes you will discover that the original question was wrong. Sometimes the answer will contradict a senior stakeholder's belief. Sometimes the data will not be good enough to answer the question conclusively.
 



  





 Knowing the difference between Fact, Inference, Hypothesis, and Unknown will be an important part of the job.
 



  





 \-\-\-
 



  





**\#\# Your Core Responsibilities** 




  





 1\. \*\*Solve ambiguous business problems.\*\* Take loosely defined questions and structure them into analytical problems that can actually be investigated.
 



  





 2\. \*\*Diagnose performance.\*\* Identify the underlying drivers behind important business movements rather than simply reporting the movement.
 



  





 3\. \*\*Generate insights.\*\* Find patterns, relationships, exceptions, and opportunities that are not obvious from standard reporting.
 



  





 4\. \*\*Challenge assumptions.\*\* Test prevailing explanations rather than accepting the first plausible narrative, including your own.
 



  





 5\. \*\*Create a common fact base.\*\* Help leadership distinguish between what we know, what we believe, and what we still need to find out.
 



  





 6\. \*\*Translate analysis into business language.\*\* Turn complex analysis into concise conclusions that senior leaders can understand and act upon.
 



  





 7\. \*\*Support important decisions.\*\* As you build context and credibility, increasingly contribute to recommendations, experiments, and decision\-making.
 



  





 8\. \*\*Build analytical systems.\*\* Develop reusable frameworks and diagnostic approaches so the organisation becomes progressively less dependent on individual intuition.
 



  





 \-\-\-
 



  





**\#\# What We Are Looking For** 




  





 We care much more about how you think than what your previous job title was.
 



  





 You could come from Business Analytics, Data Analytics, Strategy, Consulting, Business Intelligence, Growth, Product, Marketing Analytics, Operations, Revenue Management, Corporate Strategy, Finance, Founder or Chief of Staff roles, or other analytically intensive functions.
 



  





 You could have worked in Consumer, Technology, SaaS, E\-commerce, Q\-commerce, Fintech, Edtech, Healthcare, Retail, Manufacturing, Consulting, or something completely different.
 



  





 Industry experience is not a prerequisite. If you are a strong analytical thinker, we expect you to learn a new business.
 



  





 \-\-\-
 



  





**\#\# The Capabilities That Matter Most** 




  





 \*\*Analytical reasoning.\*\* You can take a messy problem, break it down, and determine what needs to be understood.
 



  





 \*\*Data fluency.\*\* You are comfortable working directly with data and can independently investigate a problem using tools such as Excel/Sheets, SQL, BI tools, or equivalent. You do not need to be a data engineer. You do need to be able to go behind a dashboard when the question requires it.
 



  





 \*\*Business judgment.\*\* You understand that analysis is valuable only when it improves understanding or decisions. You naturally ask: "So what?"
 



  





 \*\*Intellectual independence.\*\* You are willing to challenge an attractive explanation when the evidence does not support it.
 



  





 \*\*Intellectual honesty.\*\* You are comfortable saying "I don't know yet" and equally comfortable saying "I was wrong."
 



  





 \*\*Communication.\*\* You can take something complicated and explain it simply.
 



  





 \-\-\-
 



  





**\#\# What This Role Is NOT** 




  





 This is not primarily a MIS role, reporting role, dashboard\-building role, Tableau administration role, data engineering role, or data\-entry role. We are not looking for someone whose main contribution is producing more reports.
 



  





 If your proudest accomplishment is "I built 30 dashboards," this may not be the right fit.
 



  





 If your proudest accomplishment is "I discovered why a major business metric was deteriorating, changed management's understanding of the problem, and influenced the intervention," we want to meet you.
 



  





 \-\-\-
 



  





**\#\# Tools** 




  





 You should be comfortable with analytical tools such as Excel/Google Sheets, SQL or equivalent, and Tableau/Power BI/Looker or similar BI platforms. Python, statistics, and experimentation capabilities are useful additions.
 



  





 But we will not hire you because you know a particular tool. Tools can be learned. Analytical judgment is harder to teach.
 



  





 \-\-\-
 



  





**\#\# Experience** 




  





 Typically 5 to 10 years of relevant experience. But we are deliberately not making years, title, or industry rigid filters. If you have spent fewer years solving unusually difficult analytical problems, we would rather hear from you than automatically reject you. Likewise, ten years of reporting experience is not necessarily more relevant than five years of genuine business analytics.
 



  





 \-\-\-
 



  





**\#\# What Success Looks Like** 




  





 \*\*First 90 days.\*\* You understand the business, data ecosystem, and major economic drivers. You independently solve several high\-value analytical problems and establish credibility with senior leadership.
 



  





 \*\*Six months.\*\* Leadership begins coming to you not merely for numbers, but for: "Help me understand what's happening here." You proactively surface important exceptions, patterns, and insights.
 



  





 \*\*Twelve months.\*\* You have helped create a repeatable organisational capability for moving from Data \> Analysis \> Insight \> Decision, and reduced the analytical heavy lifting that currently sits with founders and functional leaders.
 



  





 \-\-\-
 



  





**\#\# Why This Could Be an Unusually Good Career Opportunity** 




  





 This role sits close to the Founder \& CEO and senior leadership team. You will see how a rapidly scaling company actually works: how strategic decisions get made, how growth and profitability trade off, how functions interact, how capital gets allocated, how operational constraints emerge, and what happens after the decision is made.
 



  





 The environment will not always be neat. There will be ambiguity, incomplete data, strong opinions, and problems nobody has solved before.
 



  





 For the right person, this role can become a bridge from being an analyst of the business to becoming someone who helps shape the business.
 



  





 \-\-\-
 



  





**\#\# How We Will Evaluate You** 




  





 We will not select primarily on pedigree, certifications, or familiarity with our industry.
 



  





 Our process is designed to understand: Can you think? Have you demonstrated that thinking in the real world? Can you apply it to unfamiliar business problems? Can you communicate it clearly to senior leaders?
 



  





 The process includes an analytical thinking assessment, a practical business case, and a deeper conversation about problems you have personally solved in your career.
 



  





 \-\-\-
 



  





**\#\# The Person We Are Looking For** 




  





 You may be a data analyst who has become increasingly interested in the business behind the numbers. You may be a consultant who wants to move from advising companies to being inside the problem. You may be a strategy professional who wants to become more analytically rigorous. You may be a product, growth, or operations professional who has discovered that your strongest skill is figuring out why things happen. Or you may have an unconventional background entirely.
 



  





 The common thread is: you are unusually curious about how things work. You do not stop at "What happened?" You want to know "Why?" And then "So what?" And eventually "What should we do about it?"
 



  





 \*\*If that sounds like you, we would like to hear from you.\*\*
 



  





**Only Mumbai based candidates apply.**

 Huntsman is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer.  Please refer to

 All unsolicited resumes presented by recruitment agencies are treated as pro bono information or service.

title: Growth Manager
description:
**Position:  Growth Manager** 




**Function: Growth / D2C / Marketing (Retention\+ CRM\+ P\&L)** 




**Industry Preference: D2C, FMCG, Nutrition, Wellness, Beauty, Personal Care, Lifestyle** 




**Location: Mumbai** 




**Experience: 7–10 years** 




**Reporting To: Director** 




  





**Role Overview** 




 We are looking for a commercially driven Growth \& Retention leader who can own the complete D2C growth charter with a strong focus on revenue, profitability, customer acquisition, retention, repeat purchases and P\&L management.
 



 The role will be responsible for building and scaling the D2C business by combining performance marketing, CRM, lifecycle marketing, customer segmentation, loyalty, CRO, analytics and commercial decision\-making.
 



 The ideal candidate should have experience working with a consumer\-facing brand, preferably within D2C, FMCG, nutrition, wellness, beauty, personal care or lifestyle, and should be comfortable operating at the intersection of growth, marketing, technology, analytics and business P\&L.
 



  





**1\. D2C Growth \& P\&L Ownership** 




 ·       Own the overall D2C revenue and P\&L, including revenue growth, gross margins, contribution margins, CAC, LTV and profitability.
 



 ·       Develop and execute annual and quarterly D2C growth strategy aligned with business objectives.
 



 ·       Identify opportunities to improve revenue, profitability, customer value and channel efficiency.
 



 ·       Own monthly growth targets and develop actionable plans to achieve them.
 



 ·       Monitor Revenue, AOV, CAC, LTV, ROAS, repeat rate, retention and contribution margin.
 



 ·       Drive data\-led decisions on marketing investments, product mix, promotions and customer segments.
 



  





**2\. Customer Acquisition \& Performance Marketing** 




 ·       Lead performance marketing across Meta, Google and other relevant acquisition channels.
 



 ·       Scale acquisition while maintaining a healthy CAC\-to\-LTV ratio.
 



 ·       Work with performance marketing teams/agencies to optimise campaign performance.
 



 ·       Develop strategies for customer acquisition and efficient media spends.
 



 ·       Diversify acquisition through organic, partnerships, SEO/AEO/GEO, referral and other growth channels.
 



 ·       Establish clear attribution and measurement frameworks.
 



  





**3\. Retention \& CRM** 




 ·       Own the complete customer retention and lifecycle marketing charter.
 



 ·       Increase repeat purchases, customer frequency, retention and LTV.
 



 ·       Develop lifecycle journeys for new, repeat, dormant, high\-value and churn\-risk customers.
 



 ·       Drive CRM through Email, WhatsApp, SMS, push and other relevant channels.
 



 ·       Build journeys covering onboarding, first\-to\-second purchase, replenishment, cross\-sell/upsell, win\-back, loyalty and VIP customers.
 



 ·       Use RFM, cohort and behavioural segmentation to personalise communication.
 



 ·       Track cohort\-level retention and identify opportunities to improve LTV.
 



  





**4\. Loyalty \& Monetisation** 




 ·       Build and scale loyalty, rewards, referral and membership programs.
 



 ·       Increase customer frequency and basket size.
 



 ·       Develop monetisation strategies that improve customer value without negatively impacting contribution margins.
 



 ·       Analyse loyalty adoption, repeat behaviour and profitability.
 



  





**5\. Growth Analytics \& Optimisation** 




 ·       Establish a growth dashboard covering the customer funnel.
 



 ·       Analyse cohorts, acquisition sources, retention curves and LTV.
 



 ·       Conduct A/B testing and CRO across website, landing pages, product pages, checkout and customer journeys.
 



 ·       Identify funnel drop\-offs and work with Product/Tech to improve conversion.
 



 ·       Build forecasting models for revenue, acquisition, retention and marketing spends.
 



 ·       Translate data into business recommendations for leadership.
 



  





**6\. Cross\-Functional Leadership** 




 ·       Work closely with Brand, Product, Creative, Technology, Analytics, Supply Chain, Finance and Operations.
 



 ·       Align growth initiatives with inventory, launches, pricing and promotional calendars.
 



 ·       Partner with Finance to track P\&L, contribution margins and marketing ROI.
 



 ·       Work with Product and Tech to improve D2C customer experience and conversion.
 



 ·       Lead internal teams and external agencies/vendors across growth, CRM, performance and partnerships.
 



  





**7\. Organic \& Emerging Growth Channels** 




 ·       Explore emerging acquisition channels beyond traditional paid media.
 



 ·       Develop SEO, AEO and GEO strategies to increase organic discovery and reduce dependence on paid acquisition.
 



 ·       Track traffic, conversion and revenue from organic and emerging search surfaces.
 



 ·       Identify new digital platforms, partnerships and consumer touchpoints contributing to D2C growth.
 



  





**Key KPIs** 




 ·       D2C Revenue Growth
 



 ·       P\&L / Contribution Margin
 



 ·       Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC)
 



 ·       Customer Lifetime Value (LTV)
 



 ·       LTV:CAC
 



 ·       Repeat Purchase Rate
 



 ·       Customer Retention
 



 ·       Revenue from Existing Customers
 



 ·       New Customer Acquisition
 



 ·       AOV
 



 ·       Purchase Frequency
 



 ·       ROAS / Marketing Efficiency
 



 ·       CRM Revenue Contribution
 



 ·       Conversion Rate
 



 ·       Cohort Retention
 



 ·       Loyalty Program Adoption \& Revenue
 



 ·       Organic Revenue Contribution
 



  





**Candidate Profile** 




 ·       7–10 years of experience in Growth, D2C, CRM, Retention, Performance Marketing or related consumer businesses.
 



 ·       Owned or significantly contributed to a D2C P\&L.
 



 ·       Hands\-on experience in customer retention and lifecycle marketing.
 



 ·       Experience managing performance marketing budgets and understanding CAC and ROAS optimisation.
 



 ·       Strong understanding of LTV, cohorts, RFM, retention and customer segmentation.
 



 ·       Experience building CRM automation and lifecycle journeys.
 



 ·       Strong commercial mindset and understanding of growth, revenue and profitability.
 



 ·       Comfortable working with data and making decisions based on analytics.
 



 ·       Experience managing cross\-functional teams and external agencies.
 



 ·       Able to operate in a fast\-paced, entrepreneurial environment with high ownership.
 



  





**Preferred Industry Background** 




 D2C \| FMCG \| Nutrition \| Health \& Wellness \| Beauty \| Personal Care \| Food \& Beverage \| Lifestyle \| Consumer Internet \| E\-commerce
 



 Experience with a high\-frequency or repeat\-purchase consumer category would be an added advantage.
 



  





**Preferred Tools / Platforms** 




 Shopify \| CleverTap \| MoEngage \| WhatsApp Business API \| Meta Ads \| Google Ads \| GA4 \| Unicommerce \| Marketing Automation \& CRM Platforms
 



  





**What Success Looks Like** 




 The person in this role will be expected to build a profitable and scalable D2C growth engine, where acquisition and retention work together—driving new customer growth while continuously increasing repeat revenue, LTV and contribution margins.
 



 This role is not a pure Performance Marketing or CRM role; it requires someone who can connect Growth \+ Retention \+ Analytics \+ Commercial/P\&L ownership into one business charter.
 



  





 Interested candidate can share their CV at
 **hr@aceblend.com**

title: Assistant Manager- Financial Reporting- Mumbai
description:
BDO is a global network of professional services firms with a presence in over 166 countries, revenue of over USD 14 billion, and experience of over 60 years. It’s a leading service provider for the mid\-markets with client service at its heart. BDO India Services Private Limited (or ‘BDO India’) is the India member firm of BDO International. BDO India offers strategic, operational, accounting and tax, and regulatory advisory \& assistance for both domestic and international organizations across a range of industries.
 



  





 BDO India is led by more than 300\+ Partners \& Directors with a team of over 10,000 professionals operating across 14 cities and 20 offices. We expect to grow sizably in the coming 3\-5 years, adding various dimensions to our business and multiplying and increasing the current team size multi\-fold.
 



  





 Role Overview
 



 We are looking for an experienced Financial Reporting Manager to take ownership of the financial reporting and month\-end close process across group entities. This is a hands\-on individual contributor role requiring strong technical accounting expertise, audit management capabilities, and a strong focus on internal controls and financial governance. The role will work closely with Service Lines, FP\&A, Tax, Treasury, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Compliance, and senior leadership to ensure accurate, timely, and compliant financial reporting.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 



  





 Financial Reporting \& Month\-End Close
 



  





 Own and drive the monthly financial reporting and close process across group entities.
 



  





 Ensure timely and accurate closure of monthly books within defined timelines.
 



  





 Review trial balances, general ledger accounts, and supporting schedules.
 



  





 Review and ensure accurate accounting of provisions, accruals, prepayments, depreciation,
 



 amortization, and other month\-end entries.
 



  





 Perform detailed variance analysis of actuals versus budget, forecast, and prior periods, and highlight key business drivers to management.
 



  





 Ensure completeness and accuracy of financial data across entities.
 



  





 Financial Statements \& Accounting Compliance
 



  





 Prepare and review annual financial statements in accordance with applicable accounting standards, including Ind AS / Local GAAP.
 



  





 Ensure appropriate accounting treatment for complex transactions and financial reporting matters.
 



  





 Provide accurate financial information, schedules, and supporting documentation for regulatory and statutory filings.
 



  





 Partner with the Compliance and Secretarial teams to ensure timely and accurate regulatory reporting.
 



  





 Statutory \& Internal Audit Management
 



  





 Lead and manage statutory audits across group entities.
 



  





 Coordinate and support internal audits, including preparation of audit schedules, reconciliations, supporting documents, and deliverables.
 



  





 Act as the key point of contact between auditors and internal stakeholders.
 



  





 Manage audit timelines and ensure timely closure of audit observations and queries.
 



  





 Proactively identify and resolve audit issues with minimal escalation.
 



  





 Internal Financial Controls \& Governance
 



  





 Execute and monitor Internal Financial Controls over Financial Reporting (IFCR/IFC) within the reporting function.
 



  





 Ensure appropriate documentation and testing of key financial controls.
 



  





 Identify control gaps and drive timely remediation.
 



  





 Strengthen financial governance and control frameworks across entities.
 



  





 Ensure compliance with internal policies, accounting standards, and reporting requirements.
 



 Lease Accounting \& Fixed Assets
 



  





 Manage lease accounting, including maintenance of lease trackers and periodic accounting entries.
 



  





 Ensure appropriate accounting and reporting under Ind AS 116, where applicable.
 



  





 Oversee fixed asset accounting, including capitalization, depreciation, disposals, and reconciliation.
 



  





 Ensure accuracy and completeness of fixed asset registers and related schedules.
 



 Balance Sheet \& Month\-End Governance
 



  





 Ensure all balance sheet schedules are prepared, reviewed, and reconciled on a monthly basis.
 



  





 Maintain strong controls over provisions and expense recognition.
 



  





 Ensure appropriate cut\-off procedures and completeness of expense recognition.
 



  





 Investigate and resolve long\-outstanding reconciling items and unusual balances.
 



  





 Drive high standards of accuracy and financial discipline across the reporting process.
 



 Stakeholder Management
 



  





 Collaborate closely with Service Lines, FP\&A, AP, AR, Tax, Treasury, Compliance, and other cross\-functional teams.
 



  





 Provide management with relevant financial information, analysis, and insights.
 



  





 Partner with stakeholders to resolve accounting, reporting, and close\-related issues.
 



  





 Build strong working relationships with senior stakeholders and external auditors.
 



 Process Improvement \& Systems
 



  





 Identify opportunities to improve and standardize financial reporting and close processes.
 



  





 Drive standardization of reconciliations, reporting schedules, and management reporting formats.
 



  





 Identify opportunities to strengthen controls and improve process efficiency.
 



  





 Support enhanced utilization and optimization of ERP systems such as Microsoft Dynamics 365, SAP, or Oracle.
 



  





 Drive process improvements, automation, and reporting efficiencies wherever relevant.
 



  





 Qualifications \& Experience
 



  





 Chartered Accountant (CA) Mandatory.
 



  





 3\+ years of post\-qualification experience in financial reporting, accounting, controllership, or related finance functions.
 



  





 Strong hands\-on experience in:
 



  





 Financial reporting and financial statements
 



  





 Month\-end and year\-end close
 



  





 Statutory and internal audits
 



  





 Balance sheet reconciliations
 



  





 Internal financial controls
 



  





 Technical accounting
 



  





 Experience managing reporting across multiple entities will be preferred.
 



  





 Experience in professional services, consulting, Big 4, or similar environments will be an advantage.
 



  





 Working knowledge of ERP systems such as Microsoft Dynamics 365, SAP, or Oracle

For example, the impact of central bank interest rate decisions on currency markets, or the relationship between the price of oil and the performance of emerging market currencies.

Our trading desks specialise in understanding flows across interest rates and FX in G10 and emerging market currencies, including: government bonds, agency and supra\-sovereign bonds, commercial paper, interest rate derivatives (including structured products), inflation\-linked products, cross currency derivatives, spot foreign exchange, foreign exchange forwards and options.

title: Marine Cargo loss control Specialist surveyors at Mumbai
description:
We’re Hiring \| Marine Loss Control \& Risk Engineering Specialist \| Mumbai
   

  

 We are looking for an experienced Marine Loss Control \& Risk Engineering Specialist to strengthen our Marine Cargo Risk Management and Loss Prevention function.
   

 The position requires a professional with a minimum of 10 years of relevant experience in logistics, cargo handling, marine/transit risk management, loss prevention, root\-cause
   

 analysis and operational gap assessment.
   

  

 The role will focus on proactively identifying why cargo losses occur and how recurrence can be prevented.
   

  

 The specialist will undertake field\-level risk assessments and detailed root\-cause/gap analysis covering exposures such as wet damage, improper handling, shocks \& jolts, inadequate packaging, stowage and stacking failures, compression/load stresses, lashing and securing deficiencies, contamination, cargo characteristics and other logistics\-related causes of loss.
   

  

 A critical part of the role will involve analysing Claims MIS, historical loss trends, survey reports and operational data to identify recurring patterns and loss drivers, correlate field observations with claims experience, and translate the findings into practical and measurable Loss Prevention / Loss Control recommendations for insured clients.
   

  

 The specialist will also support Marine Underwriting by assessing complex or critical cargo exposures prior to risk acceptance, identifying potential loss scenarios and providing technically supported risk insights, warranties, safeguards and loss\-control recommendations to assist underwriting decisions.
   

  

 Preferred Professional Background: Master Mariner / Chief Officer / Second Engineer; or an experienced Engineer / Packaging Specialist with strong practical knowledge of logistics and cargo handling. Candidates from relevant marine, engineering, cargo risk or industrial packaging backgrounds may also be considered where they can demonstrate expertise in packaging design and adequacy, compression/load stresses, palletisation, stacking, stowage planning, lashing, securing and cargo\-handling risk assessment.
   

  

 The successful candidate should demonstrate strong analytical and investigative capability, field presence, technical judgment and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to convert complex observations and loss data into clear gap analyses and actionable recommendations.
   

 The position requires willingness to travel extensively for field risk inspections and client engagements, along with excellent technical report\-writing and presentation skills. Strong proficiency in MS Excel and PowerPoint is essential for claims analytics, trend analysis and management/client presentations.
   

  

 Location: Mumbai
   

 Level: Mid\-Senior
   

  

 Experience: Minimum 10 years relevant experience
   

  

 Function: Marine Cargo Risk Management \| Loss Control Engineering \| Loss Prevention \| Risk Engineering
   

 We are looking for a professional who can move beyond conventional inspection and reporting — someone capable of understanding what can go wrong, why losses are occurring, where the control gaps exist, and what engineering interventions can prevent the next loss.

**About Business line/Function:** 
 Prime Services leverages the banks experienced global team with in\-depth market knowledge to provide execution, clearing and financing solutions across asset classes to both Institutional and Hedge fund clients.
   

  

**Position Purpose:** 
 Global Market Quantitative Research (GMQR) Team is responsible for most aspects of quantitative research within the Global Market universe, covering Interest Rates, FX, Credit, and Equity. There are teams in London, New York and Asia supporting trading activities of the flow and structured desks. They are responsible for the development of pricing, risk, margin, and profitability models and their implementation in the global analytics library.
   

  

 GMQR Prime Services is in charge of providing expert solutions to the Equity Prime Services suite of businesses for both trading / client facing activities and internal cost optimization. It covers modelling of rates, client analytics, stock loan automation/optimization, funding/resource optimization, inventory management and Delta One basket pricing. The teams develops sophisticated models and put in place the infrastructure and the technology to develop, support and optimize the activity and facilitate trading.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Within GMQR Prime Services, the role focuses on all areas of the Prime Service business – ranging from client pricing, stock loan automation / pricing, funding \& resource optimization, inventory management and Delta One pricing. This is a front office Associate quantitative research role.
   

  

* Participate in global research on various aspects of pricing of Cash PB, Synthetic TRS and Baskets
* Contribute to the design and development of Inventory Management tools.
* Development of a variety of models to estimate factors such as inventory depletion, short interest etc
* Support the legacy suite of applications (primarily python) and contribute to the design and build of both tactical and strategic future solutions.

description:
**Job Description:**
 This is an opportunity for an experienced Senior Risk Regulatory Reporting Analyst to play a pivotal role in ensuring Citi's compliance with Indian regulatory requirements, directly shaping the quality and integrity of credit risk data submitted to the Reserve Bank of India. Based within Citi's Risk Data Analytics, Reporting and Technology function, you will own end\-to\-end regulatory reporting processes across credit bureaus, working closely with senior leadership, business teams, and oversight functions to deliver accurate, timely, and audit\-ready submissions. Your work will directly influence Citi's regulatory standing in India and the reliability of data used for portfolio monitoring and strategic decision\-making.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Manage the preparation and submission of credit risk regulatory reports to the Reserve Bank of India, ensuring all returns meet accuracy and timeliness requirements.
* Oversee the submission of credit data to four credit bureaus, monitoring data quality metrics and taking corrective action where rejection rates or quality index scores require improvement.
* Conduct root cause analysis on data rejected by credit bureaus and present findings and improvement plans to senior management to drive measurable gains in reporting quality.
* Coordinate fortnightly resubmission of rejected credit records across all bureaus, ensuring each cycle is completed within prescribed regulatory timelines.
* Monitor and resolve customer complaints and disputes received from credit bureaus and directly from customers, liaising with the internal ombudsman function and meeting regulatory resolution deadlines.
* Issue regulatory default notifications to affected customers following each fortnightly reporting cycle, in accordance with compliance obligations.
* Partner with business, risk, and technology teams to support the implementation of compliance frameworks and respond to audit, governance review, and regulatory inspection requirements.
* Provide business analysis input to risk data platforms and tools, contributing to solutions that improve reporting efficiency and meet ad hoc regulatory requests.


**Required Qualifications \& Skills**
* 10 or more years of experience in financial services, with direct exposure to risk regulatory reporting in the Indian banking context.
* Demonstrated ability to manage regulatory reporting obligations independently in a high\-volume environment where priorities shift frequently.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office tools including Excel, Word, and PowerPoint, with practical use of VBA for reporting automation or process efficiency.
* Clear and confident communicator at all levels, with the ability to present complex data quality findings and compliance updates to senior stakeholders.
* Track record of managing multiple concurrent regulatory deliverables without compromising accuracy or deadline adherence.


**Beneficial Skills \& Qualifications**
* Hands\-on experience with Credit Information Companies reporting, including bureau submission processes and data quality frameworks.
* Familiarity with programming concepts, automation tools, or risk data systems that support regulatory reporting workflows.
* Exposure to RBI onsite inspections, internal audit reviews, or credit risk governance frameworks within a banking environment.


 What We Offer
   

  

 At Citi, you will work within a high\-performing regulatory reporting function that operates at the intersection of risk, technology, and compliance, giving you direct influence over decisions that matter at a franchise level. This is a role where your expertise shapes outcomes, and your contributions are visible to senior leadership across the business.
   

  

* A hybrid working arrangement with 3 days in the office and 2 days working remotely, giving you flexibility alongside meaningful in\-person collaboration.
* Direct exposure to senior risk, finance, and business leadership, positioning you to build influence and advance your career within a global financial institution.
* Access to learning and development resources that support your continued growth in risk reporting, regulatory compliance, and financial services.
* A performance\-driven environment where your analytical contribution to regulatory quality and compliance has a measurable impact on Citi's standing with regulators.
* Wellbeing and financial benefits aligned to your location, as part of Citi's broader commitment to supporting its people.
* The opportunity to work on cross\-functional initiatives spanning risk, technology, and audit, broadening your professional experience across the firm.


 Apply now to bring your regulatory reporting expertise to one of the world's leading financial institutions and take ownership of a critical compliance function within Citi India.

title: Senior Lead - Strategy
description:
**Who are we and what do we do?**
 BrowserStack is the world’s leading cloud\-based software testing platform, empowering over 50,000 customers—including Amazon, Microsoft, Meta, and Google—to deliver high\-quality software at speed. Founded in 2011 by Ritesh Arora and Nakul Aggarwal, the company has grown to support more than two million tests daily across 22 global data centers, providing instant access to 35,000\+ real devices and browsers.
   

  

 With over 1,200 employees and a remote\-first approach, BrowserStack operates at the intersection of scale, reliability, and innovation. Its suite of products spans manual and automated testing, visual regression, accessibility, and test management—all designed to simplify the testing process for modern development teams. Behind the scenes, BrowserStack continues to push the boundaries with AI capabilities like smart test case generation and design, flakiness detection, auto\-healing and more —helping teams reduce maintenance overhead, debug faster, and catch issues earlier in the development lifecycle.
   

  

 Recognized for its innovation and growth, BrowserStack has been named to the Forbes Cloud 100 list for four consecutive years. With backing from investors like Accel, Bond, and Insight Partners, the company continues to expand its product offerings and global footprint. Joining BrowserStack means being part of a mission\-driven team dedicated to shaping the future of software testing.
   

  

**Location: This is a remote position; however, the role requires the candidate to be based in Mumbai.**
**Role In a Nutshell**
 Strategy team is responsible for identifying short\-term \& long\-term opportunities across developer markets \& product lines to accelerate BrowserStack’s revenue growth \& to develop the vision for BrowserStack with a strong strategy plan \& hypotheses backed by data. Reporting to Senior Manager, Strategy, this individual will work closely with other Product, Marketing \& Sales Heads.
   

  

**Desired Experience**
* The ideal candidate will bring 5\+ years experience with at least 2\+ years experience in management consulting, Growth, BizOps \& Strategy.
* Has superior strategic, analytic, and problem\-solving skills, and is capable of clearly communicating a long\-term vision across the company and clients.
* Is integrated into the developer or saas market ecosystem stays current on competitive and market trends, and brings those insights to identify strategy for cross\-selling.
* Natural collaborator, with excellent communication skills and strong executive presence. Must be disciplined and comfortable with ambiguity, possessing the maturity and capability to interact and influence across multiple levels and a global matrixed organization
* Exhibit relevant and consistent leadership behaviors in team management, customer communications, and internal interactions with peers, senior management, clients, and third\-party vendors.
* Ability to structure, manage, and coordinate multiple complex cross\-functional projects and processes with multiple stakeholders at both senior and junior levels


**What will you do?**
* Conduct in\-depth research and analysis of market trends, competitor landscape, and customer needs and formulate data\-driven strategies to enhance product revenue and market share.
* Lead key select projects or major work streams related to Browsertsack’s overall Growth Drivers to ultimately drive recommendations to the Executive Committee
* Identify, prioritize, structure, and manage complex issues that drive product priorities and demonstrate bottom\-line results including long\-term monetization and commercialization strategies
* Work closely with cross\-functional teams, to ensure seamless implementation of finalized Strategies
* Take ownership of the entire strategic initiative lifecycle, from conceptualization and formulation to execution and outcome assessment. Ensure that strategies are effectively implemented and measure success against predefined metrics, with a focus on achieving tangible dollar benefits.
* Work with limited direction, usually within a complex and often ambiguous environment, to drive rigorous, fact\-based recommendations to executives, functional, or regional management


**Benefits**
 In addition to your total compensation, you will be eligible for following benefits, which will be governed by the Company policy:
   

  

* Medical Insurance: Comprehensive INR 5,00,000 coverage for employee, spouse, up to 2 dependent children, and parents or parents\-in\-law
* Statutory Benefits: Gratuity per the Payment of Gratuity Act, 1972
* Paid Time Off: 25 days of paid leave annually (Annual \& Sick Leave) plus gazetted public holidays and special life\-event leaves
* Remote\-First work environment that allows our people to work from home
* Remote\-First Allowance for home office setup, connectivity, accessories, co\-working spaces, wellbeing to ensure an amazing remote work experience

title: AVP - Product Controller Securitized Products
description:
**About Us** 




 Jefferies Financial Group Inc. (‘‘Jefferies,’’ ‘‘we,’’ ‘‘us’’ or ‘‘our’’) is a U.S.\-headquartered global full service, integrated investment banking and securities firm. Our largest subsidiary, Jefferies LLC, a U.S. broker\-dealer, was founded in the U.S. in 1962 and our first international operating subsidiary, Jefferies International Limited, a U.K. broker\-dealer, was established in the U.K. in 1986\. Our strategy focuses on continuing to build out our investment banking effort, enhancing our capital markets businesses and further developing our Leucadia Asset Management alternative asset management platform. We offer deep sector expertise across a full range of products and services in investment banking, equities, fixed income, asset and wealth management in the Americas, Europe and the Middle East and Asia.
 




  





**Job Description – Assistant Vice President (AVP) – Product Control, Securitized Products** 




**Business Coverage:** 
 Global Securitized Products / Fixed Income Businesses
 



  





 We are seeking a highly motivated Assistant Vice President to join the Product Control team supporting the Global Securitized Products business. The role will be responsible for daily P\&L production, balance sheet substantiation, valuation controls, inventory analysis, and financial reporting. The successful candidate will work closely with Front Office, Operations, Balance Sheet control, Valuation Control, Regulatory Reporting, Audit, Technology and other Finance stakeholders across multiple regions.
 



 This is an excellent opportunity for a candidate looking to gain exposure to structured products, securitized assets, financial controls, and strategic automation initiatives within a global investment banking environment.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**Daily P\&L and Financial Control** 



* Own and review and explain P\&L movements, including flash versus formal P\&L differences and lifecycle P\&L events for securitized products businesses.
* Analyze and explain daily inventory changes, investigations, funding impacts, mark\-to\-market movements, and risk sensitivities.
* Deliver clear and concise P\&L commentary to senior management and trading desks.
* Prepare and review valuation adjustments, reserves, and inventory\-related adjustments.
* Ensure accurate month\-end and quarter\-end financial reporting and sign\-off.



**Balance Sheet and Inventory Control** 



* Perform daily and monthly balance sheet substantiation including other assets and other liabilities.
* Review inventory positions and investigate unexplained movements.
* Analyze inventory adjustments and valuation changes.
* Support Level 3 asset reporting and fair value disclosures.
* Ensure consistency between front\-office systems, subledgers, and the general ledger.



**Reconciliations and Reporting** 



* Ensure general Ledger substantiation for P\&L and Balane sheet items.
* Ensure completeness and accuracy of financial reporting
* Prepare management dashboards and control reports.
* Support regulatory, audit, and governance reporting requirements.



**Process Improvement and Automation** 



* Identify opportunities to improve efficiency and strengthen controls.
* Partner with Technology teams to enhance reporting infrastructure.
* Participate in UAT testing and implementation of system enhancements.
* Support automation initiatives utilizing reporting and finance platforms.



**Stakeholder Management** 



* Liaise with Trading, Operations, Risk, Treasury, Accounting, FP\&A, and Technology teams.
* Escalate control issues on a timely basis.



  





**Required Qualifications** 




**Education** 



* Bachelor’s degree in finance / accounting, or a related discipline.
* CA / CPA / CFA / MBA preferred.



**Experience** 



* 8–10 years of experience in Product Control, Financial Control, Valuation Control, Risk, Treasury, or Capital Markets Finance.
* Experience supporting Fixed Income, Structured Products, Credit Products, ABS, MBS, CLOs, Loans, or Securitized Products is preferred.
* Strong understanding of:
* P\&L attribution
* Financial reporting
* Balance sheet controls
* Valuation concepts
* Reconciliations
* Accounting fundamentals



**Technical Skills** 



* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills.
* Strong analytical and data\-management capabilities.
* Experience with reporting, reconciliation, or finance platforms.
* Knowledge of SQL, Power BI, Alteryx, Python, or similar tools is an advantage.



  





**Preferred Candidate Profile** 



* Product Control experience within an Investment Bank.
* Experience supporting Fixed Income or Securitized Products desks.
* Demonstrated experience driving process improvements.
* Comfortable interacting directly with Front Office trading personnel and senior Finance management.

title: Sustainability Consultant
description:
**Role Overview** 
  

  

 The candidate should be well versed in ESG, sustainability reporting, ESG ratings and assessments, with demonstrated experience of working with corporate clients to strengthen ESG disclosures, improve performance against leading ESG assessment frameworks and support sustainability\-related business decisions.
   

  

 Candidates with experience in sustainability consulting, ESG reporting/advisory, ESG ratings or corporate sustainability functions would be preferred.
   

  

**Job Requirements** 
  

  

 \* Strong understanding of ESG principles, sustainability issues, ESG governance frameworks and global sustainability reporting and disclosure standards.
   

 \* Demonstrated experience in sustainability reporting and disclosures aligned with frameworks such as GRI, BRSR/BRSR Core, IFRS S1 \& S2, ESRS, CSRD,  CSDDD SFDR, EU Taxonomy, Integrated Reporting Framework, TCFD and SASB, among others.
   

 \* Hands\-on experience in ESG ratings and assessment frameworks such as S\&P Global Corporate Sustainability Assessment (CSA), CDP and EcoVadis. Exposure to MSCI ESG and Sustainalytics methodologies would be an advantage.
   

 \* Experience in conducting ESG rating gap assessments, including question\-level assessment of existing practices, policies, disclosures, quantitative performance and supporting evidence.
   

 \* Ability to identify improvement opportunities and develop prioritized ESG rating and disclosure improvement roadmaps based on assessment requirements, peer practices and sector benchmarks.
   

 \* Experience in developing Sustainability Reports, ESG Reports and Integrated Reports, including report structure, content development, management approach disclosures, performance narratives and case studies.
   

 \* Ability to conduct peer benchmarking and ESG maturity assessments across companies and sectors covering policies, targets, commitments, ESG KPIs, governance mechanisms and disclosure practices.
   

 \* Strong understanding of ESG data requirements and data management, including development of data collection templates, KPI definitions, calculation methodologies, data validation and supporting documentation.

title: Performance Marketer – Digital & Lead Generation
description:
Department: Growth / Performance Marketing
 





 Location: Cocoma Digital HQ – Andheri West, Mumbai
 





 Employment Type: Full\-Time \| On\-site
 





 Experience Required: 2–5 Years
 





 Reporting To: Head of Growth / Performance Marketing Lead
 




  





**ABOUT COCOMA DIGITAL \& STUDIOS** 





 Cocoma Digital \& Studios is a growing creative and marketing company managing multiple brands and businesses. Our Digital division focuses on YouTube, social media, performance marketing, content, creator collaborations, and digital brand building, while our Studios division provides end\-to\-end post\-production for films, TV, OTT, web series, and social content. We create engaging content and performance\-driven digital solutions that build communities and deliver measurable growth.
 




  





**ROLE OVERVIEW** 




 We are looking for a
 **Performance Marketing Specialist** 
 to manage and scale paid media campaigns across client accounts. The role focuses on
 **Google Ads, YouTube Ads, Meta/Instagram Ads, and Lead Generation** 
 , including campaign setup, targeting, budgets, tracking, optimisation, and reporting.
 



 The ideal candidate combines strong
 **platform expertise, analytical thinking, and commercial understanding** 
 to drive qualified leads, conversions, and measurable client growth.
 



  





**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** 





 1\. Lead Generation \& Conversion
 



* Plan, build, launch, and optimise lead generation campaigns across Meta Ads and Google Ads.
* Manage lead\-generation campaigns from audience targeting and creative selection through to lead capture and conversion.
* Generate high\-quality and relevant leads, with focus on lead quality rather than volume alone.
* Build campaigns for both B2B and B2C clients based on their business objectives, target audience, geography, industry, and conversion requirements.
* Optimise Meta Lead Forms, landing\-page campaigns, calls, messages, and other conversion pathways.
* Monitor Cost Per Lead (CPL), Cost Per Acquisition (CPA), conversion rate, and lead quality.
* Work with client and internal teams to understand lead quality and improve campaign targeting and performance.
* Identify funnel drop\-offs and recommend improvements across creatives, targeting, forms, landing pages, and conversion journeys.
* Ensure campaign\-generated leads are properly captured, tracked, and reported.




 2\. Google Ads \& YouTube Advertising
 



* Build, launch, manage, and optimise campaigns through Google Ads and YouTube Ads.
* Manage audience targeting, geographical targeting, placements, bidding, budgets, and campaign objectives.
* Understand different YouTube advertising formats and campaign structures.
* Monitor campaign performance across views, clicks, engagement, conversions, and cost metrics.
* Optimise campaigns based on CPV, CPM, CTR, CPC, CPA, conversions, and campaign objectives.
* Coordinate with creative and content teams to ensure video assets are suitable for paid amplification.
* Understand the relationship between organic YouTube content performance and paid video campaigns.




 3\. Meta Ads \& Instagram Advertising
 



* Build, launch, manage, and optimise campaigns through Meta Ads Manager for Facebook and Instagram.
* Manage campaigns across objectives including awareness, traffic, engagement, lead generation, and conversions.
* Set up and optimise Meta Lead Generation campaigns and lead forms.
* Manage Custom Audiences, Lookalike Audiences, retargeting, geographical targeting, and demographic targeting.
* Optimise Reels, Feed, Stories, and other relevant placements.
* Monitor creative\-level performance and identify high\-performing audiences, formats, messaging, and creatives.
* Work closely with the creative and social media teams to continuously improve campaign performance.




 4\. Campaign Execution \& Account Management
 



* Manage multiple paid\-media accounts simultaneously across different clients, industries, audiences, and budgets.
* Build campaigns according to documented client requirements, objectives, geography, demographics, audience profiles, and budgets.
* Handle campaign setup, targeting, tracking, launch, monitoring, optimisation, and closure.
* Conduct regular account health checks to identify performance issues and opportunities.
* Ensure campaigns are launched accurately and within agreed timelines.
* Maintain proper documentation of campaign structures, budgets, audiences, creatives, and performance.




 5\. Budget Management \& Optimisation
 



* Monitor daily ad spend across multiple client accounts.
* Ensure campaign budgets are paced correctly against approved monthly or campaign\-level spends.
* Adjust bids, budgets, targeting, placements, and campaign structures based on performance.
* Reallocate budgets towards better\-performing campaigns, audiences, creatives, and objectives.
* Identify inefficient spending and take corrective action quickly.
* Optimise towards business\-relevant metrics rather than vanity metrics.
* Maintain focus on CPL, CPA, CPV, CTR, CPC, ROAS, conversion rate, and ROI depending on campaign objectives.




 6\. Analytics, Reporting \& Insights
 



* Monitor and analyse campaign performance across Google Ads, YouTube, Meta, Instagram, and relevant analytics platforms.
* Track metrics including CTR, CPM, CPC, CPV, CPL, CPA, ROAS, conversion rate, Average View Duration, retention, organic vs. paid reach, and lead quality.
* Prepare weekly and monthly performance reports for internal and client\-facing use.
* Analyse traffic sources and identify what is driving performance.
* Translate campaign data into clear and actionable insights.
* Identify trends, performance gaps, and optimisation opportunities.
* Connect campaign performance with business outcomes wherever conversion data is available.




 7\. A/B Testing \& Creative Optimisation
 



* Plan and execute A/B tests across audiences, creatives, copy, headlines, thumbnails, CTAs, lead forms, and landing pages.
* Test different hooks, messaging, formats, and creative approaches.
* Identify high\-performing creative concepts and recommend scaling opportunities.
* Work with the creative team to develop new variations based on campaign insights.
* Continuously test and optimise campaigns rather than relying on a single audience or creative.




 8\. YouTube SEO \& Organic Performance
 



* Support YouTube content performance through optimisation of titles, descriptions, tags, chapters, keywords, and other relevant metadata.
* Work with YouTube Studio and channel\-level performance metrics.
* Analyse organic content performance before recommending paid amplification.
* Coordinate with the YouTube and content teams to ensure paid and organic strategies complement each other.
* Understand the relationship between content packaging, audience behaviour, retention, and paid performance.



  





**REQUIRED SKILLS \& QUALIFICATIONS** 



* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field.
* 2–5 years of hands\-on experience in Performance Marketing / Paid Media.
* Strong practical experience managing Google Ads and Meta Ads.
* Proven experience in Lead Generation and conversion\-focused campaigns.
* Strong understanding of Meta Ads Manager and Google Ads.
* Experience managing YouTube and Instagram advertising campaigns.
* Strong understanding of audience targeting, retargeting, Custom Audiences, Lookalike Audiences, and geographical targeting.
* Strong understanding of CPL, CPA, CPV, CTR, CPC, CPM, ROAS, conversion rate, and ROI.
* Ability to manage multiple client accounts and budgets simultaneously.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving ability.
* Ability to translate campaign data into actionable recommendations.
* Strong attention to detail in campaign setup, tracking, optimisation, and reporting.
* Ability to work with creative, social media, YouTube, content, and account management teams.
* Strong ownership of campaign performance and delivery timelines.



  





**PREFERRED EXPERIENCE** 



* Experience managing
 **paid media budgets** 
 and generating qualified
 **B2B/B2C leads** 
 .
* Strong knowledge of
 **conversion tracking, Meta Pixel/CAPI, GTM, GA4, and landing pages** 
 .
* Experience with
 **YouTube Ads, YouTube Analytics, retargeting, and full\-funnel campaigns** 
 .
* Familiarity with
 **CRM/lead\-management systems** 
 and YouTube SEO.
* Prior experience in a
 **digital, social media, or performance marketing agency** 
 , with creative testing experience.



  





**LANGUAGE \& COMMUNICATION PROFICIENCY** 





 English: Professional proficiency – Mandatory
 





 Hindi: Professional proficiency – Mandatory
 





 Additional regional language: Preferred, depending on client requirements
 





 The ability to communicate campaign performance, lead quality, optimisation requirements, and recommendations clearly to internal teams and clients is essential.
 




  





**TOOLS \& TECHNICAL PROFICIENCY** 



* **Google Ads \& Meta Ads Manager/Business Manager** 
 – Mandatory
* **GA4, Meta Pixel/CAPI, YouTube Studio \& Meta Business Suite**
* **Google Tag Manager \& Looker Studio** 
 – Preferred
* **Google Sheets/Excel \& CRM/Lead Management Platforms**
* **YouTube SEO tools (VidIQ/TubeBuddy)** 
 – Preferred; knowledge of
 **conversion tracking, pixels, events, UTMs \& attribution**



  





**SUCCESS METRICS (KPIs)** 



* Achieve
 **qualified lead and conversion targets** 
 within agreed CPL, CPA, and budget benchmarks.
* Ensure
 **accurate and timely campaign launches** 
 , budget pacing, and optimisation.
* Continuously improve
 **CTR, CPC, CPL, CPA, CPV, conversion rate, and ROAS** 
 where applicable.
* Conduct regular
 **A/B testing** 
 across creatives, audiences, copy, forms, and landing pages.
* Deliver
 **accurate performance reports and actionable insights** 
 , with strong cross\-team coordination.



  





**A DAY AT COCOMA DIGITAL – PERFORMANCE MARKETER** 




 No two days are the same. You’ll manage
 **campaign performance, budgets, leads, audience behaviour, and optimisation opportunities** 
 across client accounts. Your work may include
 **Meta and Google Ads, YouTube performance, creative testing, CPL/conversion analysis, and campaign optimisation** 
 .
 



 You’ll collaborate with account, social media, content, creative, and client teams to align campaigns with digital goals. The role requires
 **analytical thinking, execution, ownership, attention to detail, and a performance\-driven mindset** 
 .

 As a Sr. Data Governance Associate in the Risk Management and Compliance Chief Data Office team, you will be part of a team responsible to oversee and govern Data Risk Management framework which proactively identifies and monitors emerging and existing risks, establishes and maintains effective controls and governance to mitigate data risks arising from inappropriate, incorrect or unauthorized provision/ consumption, classification, storage, retention and disposal of data. * Manage and mitigate data risks across storage, use, retention, and destruction in accordance with firm policy and applicable regulations
* Deliver training and enablement on tools and processes to key stakeholders and business partners;


**Required Qualifications, Capabilities And Skills**
* Minimum 6 years of experience working in a bank/financial institution within Data Governance, Data Management, Project/Program Management, Finance, Risk Controller, Internal/External Reporting, or Business Analysis

description:
**Job Description**
 We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Tableau Developer to join our team. The ideal candidate will be a self\-driven individual with a deep understanding of data visualization, business intelligence, and data modeling best practices. This role requires extensive expertise in Tableau, calculated KPI, proficient SQL window functions, and the ability to design and deliver robust, user\-friendly dashboards, including those with complex visualizations and integrated machine learning models. The successful candidate will also possess strong analytical skills to translate business requirements into technical specifications and collaborate effectively with data engineering teams, all while working independently of generative AI tools
   

  

* Design, develop, and maintain interactive and visually appealing Tableau dashboards and reports that provide actionable insights to business stakeholders.
* Develop complex calculated formulas and measures to create sophisticated calculations and aggregations within Tableau models.
* Proficiently apply various SQL window functions (e.g., ROW\_NUMBER (), RANK (), LAG (), LEAD (), NTILE (), Loop, etc.) to transform and prepare data for Tableau consumption.
* Lead and execute data modeling efforts within Tableau, ensuring optimal performance, scalability, and data integrity (e.g., star schema, snowflake schema, relationships, hierarchies).
* Collaborate directly with business users to gather and understand reporting requirements, translating them into technical specifications and compelling dashboard designs.
* Design and implement complex charts and visualizations, including but not limited to Sankey diagrams, Step charts, drill down charts, dynamic charts (dynamic KPI and Dimension using field parameter) where number of charts or kpi’s and dimensions in a chart can be altered to represent intricate data flows and trends.
* Integrate and present outputs from machine learning models within Tableau reports and dashboards.
* Architect and design end\-to\-end Tableau solutions, considering data sources, data transformation, data models, security, and deployment strategies.
* Provide clear and concise data requirements and specifications to data engineers for data ingestion, transformation, and warehousing initiatives.
* Optimize Tableau reports and dashboards for performance; including query optimization, data source connectivity, and visual rendering.

* Stay up\-to\-date with the latest Tableau features, industry trends, and best practices.

**Required Skills and Qualifications:**
* Education: Bachelor degree in Analytics, Data Science, Business, Statistics, or a related field.
* 5\+ years of hands\-on experience as a Tableau Developer.
* Demonstrable expertise in data modeling principles and practices within Tableau, including understanding of relationships, cardinality, cross\-filter direction, and custom SQL for data transformation.
* Strong proficiency in SQL, including extensive experience with all types of SQL window functions (e.g., analytic, ranking, aggregate, value, distribution functions).
* Experience in integrating outputs from machine learning models into Tableau reports and dashboards.
* Experience working with various data sources (SQL Server, Azure Synapse, Excel, SharePoint, APIs, etc.).
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills, with a keen eye for detail.
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to articulate technical concepts to non\-technical stakeholders and provide clear requirements to data engineers.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team, managing multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* A strong commitment to independent work and problem solving, without reliance on generative AI tools.

* Experience of working with data that belongs to a process, such as manufacturing, supply chain, or business workflows.

description:

This data feeds our broad suite of ESG solutions, including our market\-leading Corporate Rating.
   

  

**Overview**
 ESG analysts research to evaluate a company's performance areas across the full range of ESG themes, including working conditions, supply chain management, sustainability governance, environmental management, and emission and resource consumption. Daily tasks include reviewing company documents such as sustainability reports, annual reports and corporate websites, and identifying, analysing and processing relevant qualitative and quantitative data in line with ISS ESG’s methodology. Our teams are based in the Philippines, the US, Australia, Germany, Sweden, India, and the UK. The successful candidate will work both independently as well as collaboratively with the local team and colleagues across our global offices. Working in a dynamic market and international environment, we put great emphasis on cooperation and offer a welcoming, collegial working atmosphere.
   

  

 Our analysts stand for research integrity and a thorough methodical approach, paying attention to detail to achieve relevant, accurate and reliable results. Being able to see the big picture as well as critical thinking are considered key factors for success. ISS STOXX ESG offers unique development opportunities for ESG generalists as well as thematic or sector specialists. title: MSET QR Corporate Actions_Senior Manager_Institutional Equity Division
description:
**Company Profile**
 Morgan Stanley is a leading global financial services firm providing a wide range of investment banking, securities, investment management and wealth management services. The Firm's employees serve clients worldwide including corporations, governments, and individuals from more than 1,200 offices in 43 countries.
   

  

 As a market leader, the talent and passion of our people is critical to our success. Together, we share a common set of values rooted in integrity, excellence and strong team ethic. Morgan Stanley can provide a superior foundation for building a professional career \- a place for people to learn, to achieve and grow. A philosophy that balances personal lifestyles, perspectives and needs is an important part of our culture.
   

  

**Department Profile**
 From global institutions to hedge funds, investors come to Morgan Stanley for sales, trading, and market\-making services in almost every type of financial instrument in all the world’s financial markets. Morgan Stanley professionals use our network and technology to provide liquidity and sophisticated analysis, to manage risk and execute reliably in the fast\-changing markets.
   

  

 Morgan Stanley’s Institutional Equity Division (IED) is a world leader in the origination, distribution and trading of equity, equity\-linked and equity\-derivative securities. Our broad and deep client relationships, market\-leading platform and intellectual insights enable us to be a world\-class service provider to our clients for their financing, market access and portfolio management needs.
   

  

 The Quantitative Research (QR) group designs, builds and maintains the models which drive the equity trading engines at Morgan Stanley. Our systems are used globally by both internal trading groups and clients of the firm. We utilize systematic, data\-driven approaches to understand how markets work and put those ideas in action. The team spans the disciplines of finance, econometrics, statistics, mathematics, machine learning and data analysis, with many team members well versed in multiple areas. We are looking to hire highly talented, creative individuals who are enthusiastic about research; and enthusiastic about making a contribution to a leading\-edge team, in an intellectually stimulating environment.
   

  

**Primary Responsibilities**
 This role, based in Mumbai, requires the individual to work with global Morgan Stanley Quantitative Research teams. The successful candidate will be a fast\-learning, dynamic, pro\-active and self\-motivated individual who can assist the team in maintaining and analyzing referential data, as well as generating ad hoc performance and market condition reports for clients.
   

  

**What You’ll Do In The Role**
* Responsible for analyzing ongoing corporate events like M\&As, spin\-offs, bankruptcies, reorganizations, and other corporate actions (e.g., stock splits, rights offerings, dividends, etc.)
* Timely identification and reviewing nature of the corporate action and it’s impact index memberships, weights, size, style, and industry classifications.
* Collaborating globally to deliver timely and high\-quality responses to queries related to corporate events raised by our global clients and internal teams.
* Share insights through emails and presentations by preparing deep\-dive analytical content on corporate actions, index events, and market microstructure.
* Collaborate regularly with cross\-functional teams including Sales, Trading, and Strats.


**Core Requirements**
 We are looking for a confident and outgoing individual, who has exceptional attention to detail and takes initiative.
   

  

* 5\+ years of experience in the financial sector with direct practical experience in equity markets
* Experience in monitoring activity in underlying markets to capture relevant corporate events
* Able to demonstrate practical mastery of handling complex corporate actions
* Experience in making presentations for complex corporate actions with proposed implementation to senior decision\-making Committees
* Handle client queries related to corporate actions and Equity Benchmark methodology
* A degree in quantitative discipline (e.g., BE, BTech, MS in Mathematics, Statistics, Financial Engineering, or Economics).
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate ideas clearly. Experience in writing marketing materials or trade ideas for broad distribution is a plus.
* Exceptional attention to detail.


**Complementary Skills**
* Experience in EU/EMEA markets, with active involvement in strategic decision\-making for complex corporate event implementations.
* Market knowledge on Index rebalances, Funds, ETFs, and mechanisms
* Experience or progress towards gaining proficiency in Python


**What You Can Expect From Morgan Stanley**
 At Morgan Stanley, we raise, manage and allocate capital for our clients – helping them reach their goals. We do it in a way that’s differentiated – and we’ve done that for 90 years. Our values \- putting clients first, doing the right thing, leading with exceptional ideas, committing to diversity and inclusion, and giving back \- aren’t just beliefs, they guide the decisions we make every day to do what's best for our clients, communities and more than 80,000 employees in 1,200 offices across 42 countries. At Morgan Stanley, you’ll find an opportunity to work alongside the best and the brightest, in an environment where you are supported and empowered. Our teams are relentless collaborators and creative thinkers, fueled by their diverse backgrounds and experiences. We are proud to support our employees and their families at every point along their work\-life journey, offering some of the most attractive and comprehensive employee benefits and perks in the industry. There’s also ample opportunity to move about the business for those who show passion and grit in their work.
   

  

 To learn more about our offices across the globe, please copy and paste https://www.morganstanley.com/about\-us/global\-offices into your browser.
   

  

 Morgan Stanley is an equal opportunity employer committed to building and maintaining a workforce that is diverse in experience and background. Our recruiting efforts reflect our strong commitment to a culture of inclusion, where individuals are hired, developed, and advanced based on their skills and talents.
   

  

 Our workforce reflects a broad cross\-section of the global communities in which we operate, bringing a variety of backgrounds, talents, perspectives, and experiences.
   

  

 For more information, please visit: https://www.morganstanley.com/people\-opportunities/eeo.
